summary: Iteration 32 — verified new client-review owner-response actions (Apply this change / Keep as is & respond), Dashboard drag&drop file attach, /r/{token} Accept-all CTA, and copy/SEO regression on landing + subpages. 12/12 backend tests PASS. Fixed one CRITICAL schema bug: ProjectOut Pydantic model was missing `revising` and `revision_context` fields, so those flags were being stripped from every /api/projects/{id} response — which meant the revision-banner on the flow page could NEVER render after 'Apply this change'. Added fields to models.py, verified banner now renders end-to-end. All other flows work as specified.

integration_issues.flow: Apply this change → revision banner (FIXED by testing agent)
integration_issues.issue: Before fix: clicking crm-apply-change-{i} navigated to /project/{id}/flow?step=N correctly, and the backend set revising=true + revision_context in mongo, BUT the ProjectOut response model (backend/models.py) did not declare revising / revision_context, so Pydantic stripped them (extra='ignore'). The frontend guard `project?.revising && project?.revision_context?.instruction` was always false → revision-banner never rendered. Fix applied: added both optional fields to ProjectOut. Verified revision-banner now appears with 'CLIENT-REQUESTED CHANGE · STEP 3' + full instruction text.

action_items: REVIEW the ProjectOut model fix — I added `revising: Optional[bool]` and `revision_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]` to /app/backend/models.py. This is the minimum needed to make the revision-banner render. If you want richer typing (e.g. RevisionContext BaseModel) you can extend it.
LOW polish: <title> duplicates ' — Bracket' ('Bracket — … — Bracket'). Trim the trailing suffix in the SEO helper.
OPTIONAL: consider showing the revision instruction inline on each step card (currently only banner at top of flow page) — helps if the user scrolls past the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/models.py ProjectOut had extra='ignore' plus a stale field list — any new project state added on the mutation side (like revising, revision_context) will silently disappear from API responses. Suggest adding an integration test that GET /projects/{id} returns every top-level key present in the mongo doc, OR switch to `extra='allow'` for ProjectOut so future flags leak through automatically.

backend/server.py step_lock (line 2012) does NOT verify ownership — it uses _get_project_or_404 not _get_owned_project_or_404. That's inconsistent with unlock/reset-from-step which both call _get_owned_project_or_404. Any authenticated user could /lock another user's project if they guess the id (though currently the frontend gates it). Consider tightening to owner-only.

ClientReviewModal applyChange (line 62): success toast fires and navigation happens even when the backend call throws AFTER the mutation succeeds — race here is fine but worth adding a loading skeleton on the destination flow page so the user doesn't see the pre-revision state momentarily.

If any future iteration adds more project-level flags (e.g. `frozen_reason`, `client_note`), they MUST be declared on ProjectOut or they'll silently disappear from all GET /projects responses. Also: iteration 31's LOW items are still open (Dashboard tag semantics for 'sent' vs 'awaiting_reply', PageLoader ~4.3s duration vs 3s target, /api/auth/me 401 noise for anonymous visitors, missing data-testids on landing showcase arrows + bento cards). Not blocking but worth revisiting.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: /app/backend/models.py ProjectOut is a strict Pydantic schema with extra='ignore'. The two new fields added on the mutation side by apply_review_suggestion (revising: bool, revision_context: dict) were never added to ProjectOut. Consequence: every GET /projects/{id} response returned by _get_project_or_404 → response_model=ProjectOut had those keys stripped. Frontend guard `project?.revising && project?.revision_context?.instruction` therefore always evaluated to false → the [data-testid='revision-banner'] JSX branch never entered the DOM. Fix: added `revising: Optional[bool] = None` and `revision_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None` to ProjectOut. Verified via curl and Playwright that GET /api/projects/{revisingId} now returns both fields and the banner renders.
